label: A100
selection: Latest retained study for each measured workload, evidence series and reference; distinct evaluation runs are preserved.
series_contract: current uses docs/precision.md; historical is previous arithmetic or hardware; captured is historical model-input forward only; experimental retains unresolved qualification limits.

coverage_gaps.status: Aggregate qualification only; no retained per-case timing samples found.
coverage_gaps.timing_status: Aggregate win counts cannot supply D512 latency values.

metadata.scope: Explicit AttentionRunner.inference versus same-runtime ordinary AttentionRunner under NoGrad; automatic dispatch unchanged.
metadata.arithmetic: docs/precision.md; forward normalization and output rounding unchanged; no backward from the explicit inference method.

qualification.covers: Output per-head FP64 norm gates, positive scales, tails, current stream, poisoned changed graph replay, training/inference cache alternation, literal training statistics and gradients, gradient/forwardAD/view rejection.

eager.scope: Complete warmed NoGrad eager wall time
